proved_formula: For one edge-triangle expansion H of a cubic G, b_ind(H)=max(B_e,T_e+2,C_e+2).
necessary_failure_conditions: If G satisfies the half bound but H fails the branch inequality, c_ind(G)=n/2, B_e<=n/2 and T_e,C_e<=n/2-2. Every maximum good set separates the edge endpoints.
derived_original_counterexample_test: Under those failure conditions, subdivide the edge once to Q. D(Q) has order 2n+2 and c_ind<=n; no such input was found.

strict_census.coverage_dependency: Existing geng input lists, compared row by row

synthesis_scope: Fixed root neighbours {1,2}; at most six deleted and six inserted edges from the recorded labelled seed. Both runs ended at wall-time limits; neither proves infeasibility.

triangle_formula_checks.verification: All vertex subsets of each expanded graph
